messages:
Jen (PM): quick design review pls — billing rail: when account scope is selected should we show an org-level condensed sparkline and hide per-project sparklines, or keep both and stack? also token denomination copy is tripping up customers.
Liz (Design): leaning toward condensing by default. org-level sparkline + a small count of top 3 projects inline. keep an affordance to expand into project rows. saves height and visual noise.
Omar (Frontend): +1 to default condensed. rendering 10+ sparklines on mobile is expensive. collapse reduces initial payload.
Kai (DataViz): if we condense, pick a consistent aggregation: sum vs median? sum = obvious for spend. for token breakdown we should show absolute tokens + a small % change. avoid stacked area for many lines — colours clash.
Alex (Eng): technical note: per-project sparklines are lazy-loadable on expand. we can render org sparkline server-side and only fetch project series on interaction. keeps initial latency low.
Liz (Design): microcopy proposals for token denom: 1) "Tokens billed" with tooltip: "1 token = ~1 input/output unit" 2) "Billing units (tokens)" 3) annotated denom in column header: "Tokens — billed units" thoughts?
Sharon (Support): customers keep asking "why does sum of projects != invoice total?" maybe we need a reconciliation link on the rail: "How totals map to invoices" that opens a short modal.
Jen (PM): good call. prioritize reconciliation link in top-right of the rail + contextual tooltip on denom. we want to reduce support noise.
Kai (DataViz): visual suggestion: org sparkline uses strong brand colour; project previews use muted stroke. hover shows exact numbers. consider a tiny stacked bar in the row to show relative contribution (no legend text required).
Omar (Frontend): CSS/layout constraints: rail width is 360px min on narrow screens. if we show project preview chips, limit to 3 chips then "+N". project expand should animate and fetch series.
Alex (Eng): implementation plan: API change to return org_aggregate and project_summaries separately. default page payload includes only org_aggregate + top_project_ids. expand endpoint fetches project_summaries. estimate: 3 dev days + QA.
Liz (Design): accessibility nits: ensure sparkline has aria-label with min/max/last value. denom tooltip must be keyboard-focusable. color choices should pass 4.5:1 for contrast where possible.
Jen (PM): decisions: 1) default condensed org-level sparkline + top-3 project chips (muted preview). 2) "Expand projects" CTA fetches per-project sparklines. 3) Add "How totals map to invoices" modal. 4) Token header copy: "Tokens billed" with tooltip copy: "Tokens = billing units for requests and responses; see invoice breakdown." 5) Accessibility: aria-labels + keyboard tooltip.
Sharon (Support): will draft a short FAQ blurb for release notes.
billing-bot: Invoice 2024-11-01 for acct:ACME uploaded — link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-9982 :paperclip:
Jen (PM): thanks all — I'll update the mock and add acceptance criteria. next sync: design pass on Wednesday.
